skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and grasp basic economic theories and concepts, as well as social issues and daily life.
Identify main ideas in clear presentations on common topics in life, work, or school.
Listen and understand basic economic speeches.
Communicate confidently about familiar topics related to personal interests, studies, and work.
Use 250-300 business-related vocabulary terms in communication situations.
Communicate confidently about business and economics.
Read and understand texts containing clear information on topics related to major fields of interest.
Extract specific information from reading materials on familiar topics in economics, business communication, and daily life.
Understand vocabulary contextually from reading materials on familiar topics in business communication and daily life.
Write simple, coherent essays on familiar topics or personal interests.
Construct a text with a coherent structure on topics related to economics, business, and daily life.
